notes: Marketplace-style restartless update, simulated: after the first LIF goal the config entry is reloaded mid-live-game (POST /api/config/config_entries/entry/<id>/reload) — the same primitive the Marketplace uses to update integrations without restarting HA. The fresh coordinator silently re-baselines at 1-0 (the padded steady window covers the reload), then the equalizer and OT winner fire from genuinely watched pairs. A zombie coordinator surviving the unload would double-fire the two later goals and halve the poll gaps — the event sequence and check_single_poller both catch it.
